name: Ariake Natsuko
source:
Tomomi's former best friend since elementary school. She has already left the prefecture to go to art college, and has not spoken to Tomomi since a certain incident.

A budding fashion designer with impeccable taste; well aware of her own beauty and a little vain. She was also the vice captain of the archery team in high school.

First became friends with Tomomi over the unusual writing of both of their given names.

(from [url=https://dialoguelostloop.tumblr.com/refinery]tumblr[/url])
